_comment: A real measurement, not a list price. Taken against production by running one frozen item through /api/live-run and /api/score and recording the cost OpenRouter reported for every call. Unpriced calls are excluded from the rate rather than counted as free. The per-prompt figure is the measured per-call rate multiplied by the calls a complete scored prompt takes, because the sampled run priced 16 of its 20 calls -- one provider was busy and its answer was never judged -- and reporting that 16-call total as the price of a 20-call unit understated it (verification finding).

full_rerun.basis: extrapolated from the measured per-call rate above across the 337-item frozen set at the published run's scope (base condition, first comparison group, so counterfactual items contribute two records each); actual cost varies with prompt length and which models are pinned
